name: Asahi (Mie, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Asahi town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing an interlaced device of three loops.
history: Municipal flag of Asahi, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 July 1964.

features.role: Asahi town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing an interlaced device of three loops
